action_items: No blocking issues found in this pass. Doc 61 and Doc 63 are production-ready for the tested surface.

Optional cleanup: fresh_user_headers fixture in test_docs_61_63_iter100.py registers a brand-new user per test (function-scope) to avoid the free-tier single-project cap; this creates ~6 disposable users per full run (safe to leave).
critical_code_review_comments: celebration_engine.py — _select_package properly applies reduced_motion (duration_seconds=2 + play.effects=false) and celebrations_enabled=false short-circuits to None. Completion record math: est_pro=round(est_high*2.4), savings=est_pro-(actual or est_high) with savings_note always set — matches Doc 63 honest-estimate rule. _evaluate_achievements is idempotent via `have` set; first_project_complete fires only when completed_count==1 which matches fresh-user first completion. Follow-up creation is idempotent via existing filter on project_id+source='post_project'.

notification_engine.py — /briefing correctly caps at items[:4], kinds match spec (safety/professional/maintenance/project/delivery). Snooze: option validation returns 400, safety category returns 409 before computing until. The 'tomorrow' path sets 09:00 next-day UTC which reads as 'moved to tomorrow morning' — good UX default.
project_planner_engine.py — /outcome endpoint sets hi_projects.status='completed' (not 'complete') which correctly matches celebration_engine.py's `if p.get('status') != 'completed'` gate.
